mainEntity.name: How long will I be without access to parts of my home during renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration you'll be without access to parts of your home depends on the scope and type of renovation. For a kitchen remodel, you might be without a functional kitchen for several weeks to a few months, requiring temporary cooking solutions. Bathroom renovations can mean 1-4 weeks without access to that specific bathroom. Whole-home renovations might necessitate temporarily relocating. We work to minimize disruption by carefully planning schedules and can often create temporary functional zones where possible. Your project manager will provide a detailed timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Access duration varies by renovation scope; a kitchen remodel can take weeks to months, while a bathroom might be 1-4 weeks. Whole-home projects may require temporary relocation. We plan to minimize disruption.
